messages:
mia: Huge thanks to @kevin for tweaking the office thermostat schedule so the conference rooms aren't saunas at 10am anymore. Sweet relief! :sweat_smile::snowflake:
kevin: Glad it helped! Turns out the holiday lighting script bumped the HVAC into 'festival mode'  who knew? I reverted the overnight profile and left notes in the room configs.
tara: You are a hero. My earbuds survived the last meeting because I wasn't melting. :pray::stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
lee: Adding to weekly kudos: Kevin 1 "Thermostat Tamer". Also leaving a small post-it on the main thermostat: "If it gets weird, @kevin is the lifeline."
ops-bot: FYI: HVAC change logged (CHG-8932). Overnight profile rollback applied at 09:03. If persistent issues, open an ops ticket via #facilities.
mia: We should document the basic thermostat troubleshooting steps in the handbook (simple: check schedule, check holiday scripts, reboot panel). @kevin want me to pair on a short note?
kevin: Sure, happy to. No plaque necessary  coffee accepted though. :coffee:
